title: Soft cells, Tubular Tilings and the Hidden Phases in Binary Mixtures
summary: Biological and physical systems ranging from Fermi surfaces and skeletal structures to reaction--diffusion patterns and cosmological models may be viewed as binary mixtures in which a smooth interface separates two complementary phases. While the interface is often directly observable, the topology of one of the phases may remain hidden. To study such systems, we introduce tubular tilings, a geometric framework for discretizing binary mixtures on smooth manifolds of arbitrary dimension and topology.
